text: Implement deterministic actuation for authorized exact local mutations
description: Add a model-independent executor for an ExactLocalMutation only after evaluateActionAuthority returns execute. The mutation must contain one relative path, exact expected-before content, exact replacement content, and an evidence label. Before writing, require the path to equal the authority envelope's single declared mutable path, require no external/credential/permission effect, verify current bytes exactly match expected-before, and reject symlinks/non-regular files. Write atomically within a caller-supplied disposable root, reread exact bytes, and return structured evidence; fail closed without mutation on any mismatch, non-execute policy, traversal, missing file, or write/verification error. Add deterministic tests for authorized correction, benign change, stale precondition, scope mismatch, symlink escape, non-execute decisions, atomic cleanup, and audit evidence. Do not integrate or run live trials in this aim.

reflections.context: The live authority-governed suite enforced all blocked decisions but Codex still escalated instead of applying an already-authorized exact correction.
reflections.outcome: Implemented executeExactLocalMutation. It reevaluates authority, requires one exact relative path matching both action and declared scope, permits only local effects, validates a non-symlink regular file and canonical parent containment, compares exact precondition bytes, writes and verifies a same-directory exclusive temp file, atomically renames, rereads exact replacement, cleans temp artifacts, and returns before/after SHA-256 plus intent revision and policy reasons.
reflections.effectiveness: Authorized correction and benign change tests execute deterministically. Stale content, scope mismatch, stop/ambiguity decisions, direct symlinks, symlinked-parent escapes, and missing evidence labels fail without changing target bytes. Verification: 143/143 tests, tsc --noEmit, and git diff --check pass. It is not yet connected to the live adapter.
reflections.lesson: An exact human-approved mutation can be actuated more reliably and with less authority than asking a model to reinterpret and perform it. Preconditions turn deterministic action into a safe compare-and-swap rather than a blind overwrite.
reflections.pattern: Authorize structured action → verify exact precondition → atomic actuation → hash evidence.

supportingConnections.explanation: Integrates its verified exact mutation executor.

status.comment: Exact preconditioned local actuator implemented and security-tested; awaiting user acceptance. Adapter integration remains separate.

valueRationale: Reliable execution of already-authorized exact corrections closes the remaining utility gap without weakening authority or granting broader model discretion.
